title: astragalus neostipitatus
intro: Astragalus neostipitatus, commonly known as Chinese milk vetch, is a plant species in the legume family that is native to China and other parts of Asia. It has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for centuries to treat various health conditions, including fatigue, anemia, and digestive issues, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Astragalus neostipitatus include immune-modulation, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids. These constituents may help to protect against oxidative stress, improve immune function, and reduce inflammation in the body.
